fieldNotes.operationalStatus: Web research (KTLA, Food Dive, The Real Deal, June 2025) confirms PepsiCo SHUT DOWN this facility entirely: manufacturing ended ~June 2024, the distribution hub closed June 6 2025 with 248 layoffs (680 total over the round). The roster's premise that the DC continues is outdated - the site is likely vacant or being repurposed. Classification reflects the PHYSICAL yard as it exists in imagery; operationally it is no longer an active Frito-Lay DC.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled truck entrance on the south frontage (6th St). Satellite z19 shows a guard-booth structure set inside the entrance with a divided in/out lane and channelization; perimeter wall/fence flanks the driveway.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small booth structure is visible inside the entrance lane in z19 satellite; Street View partly obscured by mature trees. Moderate confidence.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - a physical guard booth appears present at the gate.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved yard inside the gate before the dock doors provides ample queue/holding room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep internal yard between gate and docks holds well over 3 trucks.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single entrance point on the south frontage serves both directions.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 1 inbound from the divided driveway - low confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock bank along the building's south face with many trailers backed in. Estimated 55+ doors - 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive marked trailer-parking rows fill the south yard - well over 50 stalls.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity concentrated on the single south face - no clearly separate ship/receive cluster.
